reuse.why: Every month-wide action, including the new last-month-spending one, goes through isMonthFillCategory and the sign helper, and the #fixed check reuses the tree's extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: The selection rule and sign rule exist once; the only repetition is the category column/join SQL (has_template, group_note) written three times, in getBudgetData, setZero and getSpendingFillCategories.

placement.why: The predicate and helpers live in server/budget/actions.ts next to the actions, and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Changes are limited to month-wide actions, the new method and tests.

maintainability.why: Adding a new exclusion is a one-line change in isMonthFillCategory; the three similar SQL queries and reusing getAverageBudgetAmount for last-month spending (naming) are small blemishes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No month-wide action decides selection outside isMonthFillCategory; setZero keeps its own query but filters through the same predicate.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated SELECT of has_template/group_note in setZero and getSpendingFillCategories is visible near-identical SQL (differing only in the group join type), not a disguised copy of logic.

abstraction_drift.where: isMonthFillCategory gained includeHiddenCategories as an explicit option; template and #fixed rules were added as general conditions, and all six actions keep calling it.
